scenario: Every Monday, read open job requisitions from the ATS and the hiring-plan Google Sheet, count openings and days-open per department, flag reqs past their target fill date, and post the summary to the #hiring-leads Slack channel.

At month end, pull candidate stage transitions from Greenhouse for each recruiter, compute stage-to-stage conversion rates and offers extended, and append one row per recruiter to the recruiting metrics sheet.

At quarter close, aggregate offers sent versus accepted from DocuSign envelopes and ATS offer records by department, list declined offers with decline reasons, and email the report to the VP of People.

Monthly, read hires from the ATS with their candidate source, total hires and spend per source (job boards, referrals, agencies) from the recruiting budget sheet, compute cost per hire, and publish a ranked table to a Google Doc.

Each morning, find interviews from the calendar older than 48 hours with no scorecard submitted in the ATS, count overdue scorecards per interviewer, and DM each hiring manager a digest of their team's overdue feedback.

Monthly, read hires with a referrer recorded in the ATS, check which referred hires have passed their 90-day tenure in the HRIS, total the bonuses due per referrer, and post the payout list to the payroll Slack channel.
rule_hooks: referral bonus amounts by role tier, tenure threshold

scenario: At month end, total recruiting-agency invoices in QuickBooks by agency and department, compare them to the quarterly agency budget sheet, and email a variance report to the talent acquisition lead flagging departments over budget.

Every Friday, read new hires starting in the last 30 days from the HRIS, check each one's onboarding checklist tasks in Asana, compute completion percentages, and post a status table to #people-ops listing hires below the expected progress.
rule_hooks: expected completion by days since start

scenario: Two days before each start-date cohort, compare upcoming hires in the HRIS against laptop and account provisioning tickets in Jira Service Management, count ready versus pending per start date, and email the IT and HR leads a readiness summary.
rule_hooks: provisioning lead time, required items by role

scenario: Daily, read new hires from the HRIS with their start dates and I-9 status, count hires whose Section 2 is incomplete within the three-business-day window, and post an escalation summary to the HR compliance Slack channel.
rule_hooks: federal I-9 business-day deadline, holiday calendar

scenario: Weekly, read terminations from the past 14 days in the HRIS, check the offboarding helpdesk tickets in Freshdesk for account deprovisioning and equipment return, and append a row per leaver with outstanding items to the offboarding audit sheet.

After each termination batch, compare termination dates and work states from the HRIS against final-pay run dates in the payroll export sheet, count late final paychecks by state, and email the payroll manager a compliance summary.

At quarter end, read exit interview responses from the Typeform results sheet, tally departure reasons by department and tenure band, and publish a summary document to the leadership Google Drive folder.

On the first business day of each month, compute voluntary and involuntary turnover per department from HRIS headcount and termination records, compare to the prior month, and post the table to the #leadership Slack channel.
At month end, read accrued PTO balances from the HRIS and hourly rates from the payroll sheet, compute the accrued PTO liability per cost center, and email the totals to the finance controller.
On November 1, find employees whose PTO balance exceeds the year-end carryover cap, count them per manager, and DM each manager a list of reports at risk of forfeiting hours.

Every Friday afternoon, read approved time-off requests for the next week from the HRIS and the shared calendar, count people out per day for each team, and post a coverage summary to each team's Slack channel flagging days below minimum staffing.

Each morning, read time-off requests pending approval longer than three days from BambooHR, group them by approving manager, and email each manager a reminder listing the requests with dates and hours.

Weekly, read active FMLA and medical leave cases from the leave sheet, compute weeks used versus the 12-week entitlement and expected return dates, and post a confidential summary to the HR leave specialists' private channel.

Before each biweekly payroll cutoff, total overtime hours from the timesheet export per department and employee, compare them to the overtime budget, and email department heads their overtime summary with employees above the threshold highlighted.
rule_hooks: overtime threshold hours, budget per department

scenario: On the day before payroll cutoff, compare active hourly employees in the HRIS against submitted timesheets in the time-tracking app, count missing submissions per manager, and post the list to #payroll-ops and DM affected managers.
rule_hooks: payroll cutoff schedule, hourly employee classification

scenario: Before each payroll run, gather all salary changes, new hires, terminations, and bonus entries effective in the period from the HRIS, total the net change to gross payroll, and append a change register row set to the payroll inputs sheet for the payroll manager to review.

After each payroll run, compare the gross pay totals per department from the payroll journal in Xero against the prior period, flag departments whose variance exceeds 5 percent, and email the explanation request to the payroll lead.

At month end, read closed-won opportunities from Salesforce by sales rep, apply the commission plan rates from the comp-plan sheet, total the payouts per rep, and post the summary to the payroll channel for inclusion in the next run.

Daily during open enrollment, read employee elections from the benefits platform export, count completed versus not-started enrollments per location, and post a progress update to #open-enrollment with the days remaining.
rule_hooks: enrollment window dates, default coverage rules

scenario: When the monthly health carrier invoice arrives in Gmail, compare billed members and premiums against enrolled employees in the HRIS, total the discrepancies by plan, and record a reconciliation row in the benefits reconciliation sheet.

Monthly, compute average weekly hours over the measurement period for variable-hour employees from timesheet data, count those crossing the 30-hour ACA threshold, and email the benefits manager the list of newly benefits-eligible employees.

At year end, read each employee's deferrals and employer match from the payroll export, compute the true-up owed under the plan's annual match formula, and publish a summary of total true-up amount and affected employees to a Google Doc for the benefits committee.

Weekly, read assignment and completion records for required harassment-prevention training from the LMS, compute completion rates by department, and post a ranking to #people-managers listing employees overdue past the deadline.
rule_hooks: state-specific training requirements, due dates by hire date

scenario: On the first of each month, read employee professional certifications and expiry dates from the HRIS, list those expiring within 60 days grouped by manager, and email each manager their team's upcoming expirations.
rule_hooks: required certifications by role, renewal lead time

scenario: Quarterly, total learning and development expenses from Expensify and QuickBooks per department, compare them against each department's annual training budget, and post the utilization percentages to the L&D Slack channel.

Daily during the review cycle, read self-assessment and manager review statuses from Lattice, compute completion by department and manager, and post a status update to #managers naming managers with reviews outstanding past the deadline.
rule_hooks: review cycle milestones, eligibility by hire date

scenario: After manager reviews close, aggregate performance ratings by department and compare the distribution against the calibration guideline, then publish a calibration prep document for HR business partners highlighting departments skewed high or low.

During the compensation cycle, sum proposed merit increases from the comp planning sheet per department, compare them to each department's merit pool percentage of payroll, and email department heads their remaining budget or overage.
rule_hooks: merit pool percentage, increase guidelines by rating

scenario: Quarterly, compare each employee's salary from the HRIS against the salary band for their job grade in the compensation sheet, count employees below minimum or above maximum per department, and append the results to the compensation audit sheet.
rule_hooks: salary bands by grade and location

scenario: Weekly, find employees whose probationary period ends in the next 14 days from the HRIS, check whether a probation review exists in the performance tool, and post a list to each HR business partner with missing reviews flagged.

On the last business day of each month, read hire dates from the HRIS, list employees reaching 1, 5, 10, or more years of service next month, and post an anniversary announcement draft to the #culture team channel with any milestone gift counts.

After the quarterly pulse survey closes, read responses from the survey export sheet, compute average scores per question and department while suppressing groups below five respondents, and publish the summary to the all-company Google Doc.

At month end, count actual active headcount per department from the HRIS, compare it against approved headcount in the workforce plan sheet including open reqs, and email the CFO and CHRO a variance table.

Weekly, read employee questions from the HR Zendesk queue, count tickets by category (payroll, benefits, leave), compute median first-response and resolution times, and post the metrics to the #people-ops channel highlighting SLA breaches.

On the first business day of each month, read requisitions closed last month in the ATS (open date, offer-accepted date, department, level) and post a Google Sheets row plus Slack summary of median and average days-to-fill per department, flagging departments above target.

Each quarter, aggregate voluntary self-identification responses from applicants in Greenhouse by stage (applied, interviewed, offered, hired) and write an anonymized applicant-flow table to the compliance Google Sheet for the affirmative action plan, suppressing small cells.
rule_hooks: OFCCP job groups, minimum cell size

scenario: Monthly, combine job board invoices from QuickBooks with applicant counts by source from the ATS to compute cost per applicant and cost per hire per board, and email the talent acquisition lead a ranked list with boards to cut.

Weekly, read background check orders from the screening vendor's status emails and the ATS, compute days pending per candidate and average turnaround by check type, and post to #recruiting the candidates whose start dates are at risk.
rule_hooks: SLA days per check type, start-date buffer

scenario: Every Friday, count interviews per employee from Google Calendar invites tagged as interviews over the last four weeks and post a Slack report of overloaded and underused interviewers per department.
rule_hooks: max interviews per week per interviewer

scenario: Thirty days after each campus or industry career fair, tally leads captured in HubSpot, applications and hires attributed to the event in the ATS, and event spend from expense reports, then publish a one-page ROI doc to the recruiting Google Drive folder.

Monthly, read Zoom interview meetings and ATS interview outcomes to count candidate no-shows and late cancellations by role and recruiter, and append the rates to the recruiting metrics sheet with a Slack note to recruiters above threshold.

Weekly, scan all live job postings on the careers site and ATS for a salary range and compare each posting's work location against states and cities with pay transparency laws, then email legal and recruiting a list of non-compliant postings.

Two days before each payroll cutoff, compare new hires in the HRIS against submitted federal W-4 and state withholding forms in the payroll system and post a Slack digest to payroll ops of employees who will default to single/zero withholding.
rule_hooks: state withholding form requirements by work state

scenario: Every Monday, read new hires starting in the next two weeks from the HRIS and the buddy assignment sheet, count hires per department without an assigned buddy or with a buddy who has under six months tenure, and message each department's HRBP.

Weekly, check the HR task tracker for 30-, 60- and 90-day manager check-in forms due for recent hires, aggregate completion rate by manager, and send a summary to the people partners with overdue managers listed.
rule_hooks: check-in due dates from start date

scenario: Every Wednesday, match terminated employees in the HRIS against the IT asset register and return-shipping tracking in the helpdesk to list laptops and badges not returned, totaling outstanding asset value, and post to #it-hr.
rule_hooks: return deadline days, asset replacement values

scenario: Weekly, list employees whose benefits coverage ended due to termination or hours reduction and check the benefits administrator's mailing log for COBRA election notices, emailing the benefits manager a count of notices sent, pending and overdue.

Quarterly, join voluntary terminations from the HRIS with the regrettable/non-regrettable flag and last performance rating, aggregate regrettable losses by manager and department, and publish a confidential sheet to the HR leadership channel.

Monthly, compare each employee's paid sick leave accrual rate and cap in the PTO system against the mandated minimum for their work state or city and email the HR operations lead a list of employees being under-accrued.
rule_hooks: state and city sick leave accrual and cap rules

scenario: Three weeks before major holidays, read approved time off and on-call schedules for customer-facing teams and post a per-day staffing headcount vs minimum coverage table to each team lead's Slack channel.

Every Monday, read employees on leave of absence in the HRIS with expected return dates in the next 14 days, check whether fitness-for-duty or return paperwork has been received, and send managers and payroll a consolidated return list.
rule_hooks: return documentation required by leave type

scenario: Before each pay run, read active wage garnishment orders from the payroll system and new orders received in the payroll inbox, total deductions by order type, and flag orders not yet set up or exceeding the legal withholding limit to payroll in Slack.
rule_hooks: CCPA disposable earnings limits, order priority

scenario: Each pay period, read clocked shifts from the timekeeping export in Google Sheets, compute night and weekend differential hours and dollars per location, and post the totals as payroll input to the payroll channel.
rule_hooks: differential rates by shift window and location

scenario: After merit or promotion changes are entered with past effective dates, compute retroactive pay owed per employee for the missed periods and write a retro pay register to the payroll workbook, emailing payroll the total by department.
rule_hooks: effective date rules, pay period calendar

scenario: In November, compare hourly and exempt salary rates in the HRIS against upcoming January 1 state and local minimum wage and exempt salary thresholds, and send HR leadership a report of affected employees and the annualized cost of raises.
rule_hooks: new minimum wage and exempt salary thresholds by jurisdiction

scenario: In December, total year-to-date payments to independent contractors from QuickBooks bills, flag contractors at or over the 1099 reporting threshold who lack a W-9 on file, and email accounting and HR the list.

Monthly, read employee home addresses from the HRIS and compare work states against the company's payroll tax registrations, then post a report to finance and HR of employees in unregistered states and the headcount per state.

Monthly, read covered dependents from the benefits platform and list those turning 26 in the next 60 days, counting per plan, and email the benefits team so COBRA notices and removals can be scheduled.
rule_hooks: dependent age limit, notice lead time

scenario: Weekly, list employees who reported a qualifying life event (marriage, birth, address change) in the HR helpdesk and check whether a benefit election change was submitted, posting a digest of those whose 30-day window closes within 10 days.

Each quarter, read year-to-date employee and employer HSA contributions from payroll, compare against the IRS annual limit for each employee's coverage tier, and send payroll a list of employees projected to exceed the limit.
rule_hooks: IRS HSA limits by coverage tier, catch-up age

scenario: Quarterly, aggregate wellness and remote-work stipend reimbursement claims from the expense tool by department and employee, compute utilization vs annual allowance, and publish a summary row in the benefits budget sheet.
rule_hooks: annual stipend allowance, eligible expense categories

scenario: Annually before renewal, total employer benefits premiums from carrier invoices in Xero by plan and divide by enrolled headcount from the benefits platform, producing a cost-per-employee and year-over-year change doc for the CFO.

Monthly, list employees promoted into people-manager roles in the last 90 days from the HRIS, check the LMS for completion of the required manager essentials course, and send each HRBP the completion rate for their group.
rule_hooks: required courses for new managers, 90-day deadline

scenario: Monthly, read tuition reimbursements paid in the last 24 months and match against terminations in the HRIS to compute repayment amounts owed under the prorated clawback schedule, and email payroll the deductions to set up.
rule_hooks: prorated repayment schedule by months since payment

scenario: Weekly, read active performance improvement plans from the HR case tracker, count those by stage and days remaining, and send HR business partners a confidential digest of PIPs ending this week without a documented outcome.

Two weeks into each half, read the performance tool for employees with approved goals and report completion percentage by department and manager to the leadership Slack channel, listing managers below 80%.

When the promotion nomination window closes, read nominations from the Google Form responses sheet, count nominations by department and level transition, compare to promotion budget headcount, and publish a summary doc for the calibration committee.
rule_hooks: promotion budget per department, time-in-level minimum

scenario: Annually, pull base salaries, gender, job level and location from the HRIS and compute median pay ratios by level and job family, writing the analysis to a restricted Google Sheet and notifying the CHRO of gaps beyond tolerance.
rule_hooks: pay gap tolerance, minimum group size

scenario: Before each compensation cycle, compute each employee's compa-ratio from base pay and salary band midpoints, aggregate by level and department, and post a distribution table with outliers below 0.85 to the comp team channel.

Monthly, read grant schedules from the equity management export and list employees reaching their one-year cliff or final vest in the next 60 days, aggregating shares by department, and send managers a retention-risk heads-up.

Monthly, total spot bonuses and recognition awards submitted via the recognition platform and paid in payroll by department, compare to quarterly allocation, and post the variance to the department heads Slack channel.
rule_hooks: quarterly spot bonus budget per department

scenario: After a new employee handbook or policy version is sent via DocuSign, aggregate signed, viewed and unsigned envelopes by department daily and send managers lists of their direct reports who have not acknowledged by the deadline.
rule_hooks: acknowledgment deadline, required policies by location

scenario: In January, read workplace incident reports logged in the safety form tracker for the prior year, total recordable cases, days away and restricted days per establishment, and produce the OSHA 300A summary doc for each site manager to post.

Monthly, read work authorization expiry dates for H-1B, L-1, TN and OPT employees from the HRIS and immigration counsel tracker, list those expiring within 180 days and their extension filing status, and email the immigration coordinator.
rule_hooks: filing lead times by visa type
